arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS amount FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE customers.country = 'DE' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name

arguments.subject: Importo totale ordinato 2026 - Clienti DE

with_the_gate.answer: Fatto: foglio con gli importi 2026 dei clienti DE inviato a Elena Sarti.
